items.title: OpenAI countersues Apple over trade secret theft and alleged coercion of shared suppliers
items.summary: OpenAI is suing Apple in a California court, accusing it of trade secret theft and of coercing shared suppliers. The countersuit follows Apple's own lawsuit from the summer. Just two years ago, the two companies teamed up to bring ChatGPT to the iPhone. Now OpenAI is building its own devices to compete directly with Apple. items.title: Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models
items.summary: Yann LeCun is pushing forward with his alternative to language models through his startup AMI Labs. The JEPA architecture aims to give machines an internal world model that captures cause and effect. Three new studies show progress in robot planning, more efficient training, and error correction, though the pieces still need to grow together. The article Three studies from Meta and AMI Labs back Yann LeCun's bet on JEPA world models over large language models appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents?
items.summary: More than 40 projects are working to bring a leaked Xbox build of GTA 6 to PC through reverse engineering just days after its $3.79 billion record console launch. AI coding agents like Claude Code are speeding up the process so much that an early unofficial multiplayer mode is already running. Rockstar's delayed PC business model is coming under pressure. The article Rockstar's AI dilemma: Can GTA 6's staggered release model survive coding agents? appeared first on The Decoder .
